Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning administration of the medicaid program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to administration of the medicaid program; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: By December 1, 2010, the governor shallsubmit to the appropriate policy and fiscal committees of thelegislature a report that identifies the agency designated by thegovernor as the single state medicaid agency and a plan fortransferring, as necessary, the functions related to that designation.In preparing the plan, the governor must consider, at a minimum, thefollowing: (1) The terms and conditions of any federal medicaid waiver relatedto financing the basic health plan granted as a result of the requestsubmitted to the federal department of health and human services by thedepartment on January 19, 2010; (2) The policy goal of integrating medical, behavioral health, andlongterm care services for individuals with cooccurring disorders orcomplex health needs; (3) The need for uniform policies, based on the best available p. 1 SHB 3048scientific and medical evidence, across state purchased health careprograms as provided in RCW 41.05.013.
